headline: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams pulled up to Night 2 of Ye’s Chicago show in full
body: Chicago Bears quarterback Caleb Williams pulled up to Night 2 of Ye’s Chicago show in full disguise 😭🔥 Caleb threw on a shiesty and sunglasses before heading into the pits at Soldier Field and somehow went the entire night without anyone recognizing him 😂 Via: X/bullsmuse_
